join.step1Text: Show who you are, what you do and how you can help people in your area with more context and trust.
join.step2Text: Get contacts, talk more clearly and bring your work closer to the people who really need your service.
join.step3Text: Reviews and good experiences help your profile gain credibility and bring new recommendations.
join.helpTitle: We're here to help {br} you find what you need.
join.helpText: Whether you're looking for a professional or promoting your work, Skillsy is your place.
join.metaDescription: Sign up for Skillsy to promote your work, find opportunities and strengthen trusted connections in the community.
join.metaImageDescription: Promote your work, strengthen your reputation and create new connections in the community.
join.highlight1Text: More than closing a job, you build relationships that can bring new opportunities.
join.highlight2Text: Those who do good work get more visibility. Those who hire find help closer to home.
join.highlight3Text: When local talent supports each other, everyone wins: professionals, families and the network around them.
join.headline: Your work can create {opportunities}, {trust} connections and {support} in the community.
join.heroAlt: People and services in a community setting
join.intro: Skillsy was created to help people share their talents, find professionals with more context and strengthen a support network based on trust, service and responsibility.
join.strengthenText: Every relevant profile, every job well done and every responsible recommendation helps make Skillsy more useful for everyone.
join.whyText1: Joining Skillsy isn't just creating a profile. It's making room for your work to be seen, remembered and recommended with more confidence.
join.whyText2: The platform was designed to bring together people who need practical help and people willing to serve with quality, honesty and care.
join.findText: More visibility for local talent, more confidence when hiring and a network that can create new connections, recommendations and real opportunities.
join.noticeText1: Skillsy doesn't handle payments, doesn't technically certify the professionals listed and doesn't replace your own responsibility to evaluate a service before hiring.
join.noticeText2: The platform exists to make connections easier with more context and trust, but agreements, prices, deadlines and final decisions are still made directly between the parties.
join.ctaTitle: Work, trust and service also strengthen the community.
join.ctaText: By joining Skillsy, you help turn skills into real support and make room for opportunities to flow more clearly among people in the same network.

about.metaDescription: Learn about Skillsy's purpose, mission and values, and how the platform works to strengthen trusted connections in the community.
about.metaImageDescription: Understand the platform's mission, values and vision for strengthening trusted connections.
about.value1Text: Profiles, prices, deadlines and skills should be presented clearly and truthfully.
about.value2Text: Every connection should come from courteous communication, responsibility and consideration for others.
about.value3Text: Skillsy values using talents to create practical support, dignified income and shared benefit.
about.headline: Skillsy is a platform created to turn {talent}, {trust} and {services} into real connections.
about.heroAlt: People and services in a community setting
about.beSkillsyText: More than a directory of professionals, Skillsy was born as an independent initiative to bring people together, strengthen trusted relationships and connect those who need help with those who can serve through their work.
about.card1Text: Skillsy helps people find and present services with more closeness, context and trust.
about.card2Title: A space to make talent visible
about.card2Text: Professionals, entrepreneurs and people with useful skills can better share what they do.
about.card3Text: When hiring happens with trust, more people benefit: those who provide the service, those who hire and the network around them.
about.missionText1: To create a place where local talent can be seen more clearly, where families find help with more confidence and where good work becomes a concrete way to support the community.
about.missionText2: In practice, that means bringing people together, encouraging more responsible relationships and making it easier to discover professionals, services and opportunities that may already be nearby but aren't connected yet.
about.strengthenText: We want to strengthen a culture of responsible recommendations, reputation built on real experience, service provided with integrity and opportunities that flow within the community itself.
about.presentingAlt: Person presenting their work to the community
about.valuesTitle: The values that guide the platform
about.valuesText: Skillsy grows best when technology serves something bigger: more honest relationships, more dignified work and a community more willing to support each other.
about.notTitle: What Skillsy doesn't intend to be
about.notText1: The platform doesn't intend to replace personal judgment, direct conversation between the parties or the responsibility to evaluate a service before hiring.
about.notText2: Nor does it intend to act as an institution, an official certifier of professionals or a financial intermediary in negotiations.
about.notText3: Skillsy's goal is to make connections easier with more context and trust, not to control every relationship that comes from them.
about.howText1: You can take part by sharing your work, finding professionals, telling others about the platform or helping strengthen the initiative.
about.howText2: Every new relevant profile, every job well done and every responsible recommendation helps Skillsy fulfill its mission better.
about.noticeText1: Skillsy has no institutional, administrative or official connection with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The platform was born as an independent initiative of members who want to encourage trusted connections, practical support and visibility for talent in the community.
about.noticeText2: This means that using the platform, its content and the relationships formed through it don't represent official positions of the Church, nor do they replace pastoral or institutional guidance or the personal decisions of those who take part.
